prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, wolf cut golden blonde hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in an op-art warped chequerboard: crisp black and white squares bulging and curving as if swelling outward over her chest, hips and thighs, the squares stretching and shrinking along her arms and legs to make a three-dimensional wavy illusion, the pattern sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body — most extreme hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of polished black-and-white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black-and-white polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
